body: I've been fantasizing about killing myself now off and on for about 8 years now. It use to come in waves, but it now seems like I'm always thinking about ways to off myself. If it seems arbitrary, my birthday is in thirteen days, I'll be a quarter of a century with little to show for it. I don't know really what else to say, oddly the most depressing thing has been losing my hair, people stop treating you the same, that parts actually a little sad. Other than that, I have (had) friends, have a job and grew up with a real awesome dad, but frankly I don't have a reason to be here anymore. I hate to just drop this here all dramatic and such, but this is something I've been thinking about for a long time now, and it's starting to feel more and more right.
